title: Caging Peroxide: Anion-Templated Synthesis and Characterization of a Rare-Earth Cluster

material_class.structural_family: peroxide-templated triangular Tb3 picolinate cluster in a sodiated 6^3 net

synthesis.procedure: To a round-bottomed flask were added sodium picolinate (175 mg, 1.2 mmol), 2-acetylpyridine (147 mg, 1.2 mmol), and hydrated terbium chloride (150 mg, 0.40 mmol) in methanol (10 mL). The mixture was stoppered and allowed to stand. After about two months, colourless hexagonal crystals that fluoresce green under UV light were obtained and isolated by filtration. The main text additionally describes crystallization from solution open to air and states that repeating the reaction without 2-acetylpyridine gave no peroxide-containing product.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colourless hexagonal crystals isolated by filtration after standing about two months.

properties.summary: Solid-state and aqueous samples show characteristic green Tb(III) emission upon 300 nm excitation (5D4 to 7FJ, J = 6–3). In a 1 T dc field, χMT is 25.5 cm3 mol−1 K from 300 to 100 K and falls to 10 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K, consistent with very weak or zero antiferromagnetic coupling through the peroxide bridge and no SMM behavior in ac susceptibility.

measurements.name: excitation wavelength
measurements.conditions: solid state, water, and aqueous NaCl (2:1); emission collected as characteristic green Tb luminescence

measurements.conditions: dc field 1 T; constant between 300 and 100 K
